zoe: planning note 1 we need a field-ready battlecard and webinar landing copy focused on competitive differentiation vs cloud AI platforms, generic LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Keep language sales-friendly and 15s rebut-ready.

diego: propose two hero claims: 1) predictable p99 latency at production scale, 2) 20-35% lower per-token cost on typical app workloads via batching + KV caching. both defensible with our perf runs.

meera: i'll add a tiny bench example (2k/8k seqs) and a callout that results vary by model family. also drafting three SDR one-liners for replies.

ravi: routing rules for webinar form: fields: company, size, deployment interest [Hosted/Dedicated/Private], compliance needs [HIPAA/SOC2], bench request checkbox. tags: Dedicated -> "Dedicated interest", Private -> "Private/VPC", Compliance -> "Compliance lead", Bench -> "Bench request". routing map: Dedicated -> AM+SolutionsEng; Private -> Enterprise SE+Security; Compliance -> Security+AE; Bench -> Growth SDR+PM.

meera: SDR snippets (15s):
- vs managed cloud: "Great for early tests. For production you need runtime controls (caching, fallbacks, tracing) and transparent unit economics."
- vs LLM APIs: "APIs are fast to start but don9t give deployment flexibility or cost controls at volume."
- vs infra vendors: "Buying GPUs is step one. We deliver the runtime, rollouts, and observability you actually use."

zoe: timeline: diego slides + soundbites by Tue, meera bench graphic by Wed, ravi publishes form+routing Wed AM, finalize battlecard Thu. ops-bot: webinar slot reserved for 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT. recording auto-posts to #events.

diego: :thumbsup:

meera: :thumbsup: will share draft snippets shortly.

ravi: :thumbsup: routing PR queued.

zoe: thanks team 1 i'll collate and push the battlecard PR when ready. :rocket:
